name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText:
Ball & Chain, Loner (4+), 
Mighty Blow, No Ball, Prehensile Tail, Secret Weapon
specialRules: I’ll Be Back!: The first time in a game that Kreek would be Sent-off as per the Secret Weapon Trait, he is not Sent-off and may instead continue as part of the game. Kreek’s coach may not Argue the Call when Kreek uses this special rule.
